    "test_period_residual"

The request explicitly asks for JSON schema only and no reserve MW or coverage output.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "CISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",

    "apply_rolling_window_configuration",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "record_numerical_outputs_in_audit_evidence_trace",
    "require_human_approval_before_operational_use"
  ]
